title: page
description: The data of a list command (CLI-041): items, count and has_more always; while has_more is true exactly one of next_cursor, next_offset or continuation_reason; truncated with truncated_reason when the tool capped the list; scope echoes what the list covers (filters actually applied, and narrower-than-expected coverage such as direct members only); sort names the order; total, when the upstream reports it, is the number of items the whole list has, everything scope covers, so "how many" needs no paging (CLI-044). count is only the items in this response. check-contract.py checks that count equals the number of items, that next_offset advances past offset and that total agrees with offset, count and has_more.

allOf.description: has_more true: exactly one way to continue or a reason it cannot; has_more false: no continuation keys.
A truncated list says why and admits there is more; truncated_reason only accompanies truncated true.
